findings.title: DaemonSet matches no node
findings.cause: DaemonSet agent's nodeSelector requires the labels disktype=ssd, and none of the cluster's 1 node has them, so it runs no pods and nothing reports an error

evidence.what: DaemonSet agent should run on 0 nodes; its pods require node labels disktype=ssd
none of the 1 nodes has disktype=ssd

findings.fix: Label the nodes it should run on (kubectl label node NODE disktype=ssd), or correct the nodeSelector.
